name: BNB Chain
notes: ELPIDA V2.3 launchpad on BNB Chain (Malik, 23 November 2026): every fee split 50% traders (monthly EWPR airdrop in USDC) / 30% creator / 20% treasury; no flywheel or holder-reward vault. New launches go here; tokens of the V2.0 launchpad keep their own split. Same treasury Safe, keeper, guardian, PoolManager, feed and dollar as the BNB Chain V2.0 plan. treasury: the Elpida Treasury Safe (same address, owners and 2-of-3 threshold as on Base; add this network to it in the Safe app before `check`); keeper and guardian: the same wallets as Base (18 Nov 2026). dailyLaunchCap 1000 and minFeeBps 100 follow Malik's Base decision. PoolManager: Uniswap's v4 deployment on BNB Smart Chain (developers.uniswap.org v4 deployments). usdFeed: Chainlink BNB / USD; `check` confirms its description is BNB / USD and fresh. USDC on BNB Chain (Binance-Peg) has 18 decimals: the USDC pair's virtual quote is 25,000e18 and the $10 USDC fee is 10e18 (ElpidaUsdPricing, 13 November).
